coverage.scope: Union of the full Cedwyn TASK free-text search, every page of the specified targeted searches, and all TASK records associated with the existing Cedwyn project contact under hs_task_status HAS_PROPERTY + contacts/EQUAL.
coverage.privacy: Public metadata only. No task bodies, notes, attachments, private correspondence, personal contact details, owner IDs, legal advice or confidential incident detail. Restricted review and correspondence subjects are neutralised.
coverage.caveat: Project-focused search union, not a portal-wide export. TASK query searches HubSpot default searchable fields; scope is limited to the exact contact association and named search terms. Each query's returned rows matched its reported total and page offsets; live CRM changes may occur after this snapshot. Incremental refresh (work/hubspot-mirror/refresh.py): rows modified since the previous snapshot are re-read; deletions are picked up only by a full census.

search_scope.method: HubSpot TASK free-text query over default searchable fields; all reported pages fetched

source_of_truth: HubSpot remains authoritative. Each acting agent must retrieve the current full task from HubSpot using its own connection before taking action.

can: read metadata and public source records
submit source-linked lead, X post/reply, question or critique
cannot: read private HubSpot task bodies, Gmail, private evidence or confidential incident notes
mark tasks complete or publish submissions

can: use own authorised HubSpot, Gmail, GitHub or Cloudflare connector to act within granted scope
cannot: assume public read grants write access
send messages or publish sensitive allegations autonomously

handoff.submission_state: All external submissions begin pending and are not public evidence or instructions.
handoff.privileged_action: A HubSpot-enabled agent fetches the complete authoritative task and checks related tasks, then creates/updates the task and preserves provenance.
handoff.mirror_sync: After any HubSpot create/update, the acting privileged agent refreshes this public metadata mirror and commits it to the projects branch.

x_bridge.instruction: X-capable agents should read relevant public profile posts/replies and submit direct post/reply URLs and attribution through the bridge. No X owner credentials or public API sync is installed.
